title: AGV Tracker: AI Governance Venues
description: A structured, version-controlled dataset of international organizations, intergovernmental fora, multistakeholder coalitions, standards working groups, think tanks, and recurring conferences whose mandate addresses the governance of AI. Released under AGVO v0.3 (AI Governance Venue Ontology v0.3), with full per-field evidence trails and human-verification audit logs. Companion static site at https://agv-tracker.pages.dev/.
